title: Super VRUN music test (Windows 95)
description: A spinoff MUSIC TEST player (modelled on CTW NES's AudioPlayer): the game's real sound driver, included unchanged, every music track, one FL TEST slot (00: a song from an FL Studio project via BrokenDev/tools/music/flp/musictest/build-supervrun-95-mt.ps1; a silent placeholder here), looping, per-channel mute (1-9) / solo (F1-F9) from the keyboard with the channel state on screen, song number and name on screen. A separate build target (musictest/build_mt.ps1): the game build is byte-identical.

toolchain: Open Watcom 2.0 (wcc386/wcl386, wlink, DOS/32A), NASM 3.02, Python 3: C:\BrokenNes-tools\dos (env.ps1)

steps.name: build
steps.note: build_mt.ps1: oplconv.py, sfxconv.py, musictest/mt_flconv.py, wcc386 -bt=nt on musictest/sv_mt_win.c (includes platform/win/win_snd.c unchanged; OPLWrite filtered for mute/solo), mt_ui.c, mt_win.c, platform/win/fmopl.c; wlink nt_win: build/mt/SVMT95.EXE.

run.note: Windows 95 and up: a text window, waveOut. Same keys as DOS. Release: T:\BrokenDev\Releases\SuperVRUN_95_MusicTest.

verify.note: NOT RUNNABLE in BrokenDev: a Windows 95 exe (Win32 GUI); BrokenNes's x86 PC boots DOS only, and BrokenDev has no Windows kind (lib/Manifest.ps1 BdKinds), so kind/console say dos/x86 only to keep the manifest valid: do not run 'brokendev verify' on it. The game repo tests it on this Windows: SVMT95.EXE|VMT95.EXE /hidden /fast /wav with MT.TXT beside it -> MT.OUT, SCREEN.TXT, MT.WAV.

knownIssues: Windows exe: BrokenDev cannot run or verify it (no Windows kind); tested by the game repo's MT.TXT script on this PC.

check_imports.ps1: TextOutA, GetTextMetricsA, SetBkColor, SetTextColor, DestroyWindow, PeekMessageA are not on the repo's vetted Windows 95 list (all are Windows 95 APIs; not vetted on a real 95 machine).
